summary: Skier killed in avalanche near Marble
responding_agency: Crested Butte Search and Rescue + Western State Colorado University SAR + Gunnison County Sheriff
notes: Reported in avalanche-center 2012-13 season index; name not in opened source MERGE 2026-09-11 (run 34): Crested Butte News detail — James Lindenblatt, 37, Summit County, skiing with three friends in Raspberry Creek drainage, Raggeds Wilderness; fourth skier triggered a soft slab on a steep westerly aspect of Marble Peak Ridge Sunday afternoon and was buried/killed; companions located and dug him out but he was deceased; 8 Crested Butte SAR + 4 Western State Colorado University SAR assessed with CAIC forecasters; unstable conditions forced a Monday helicopter body recovery arranged by the Gunnison County Sheriff. [merge run-605: KVNF page corroborates same incident] Run-927 merge: CPR/AP-wire report (parent-opened, same Aspen Public Radio wire as KVNF story) — adds Gunnison County Undersheriff Randy Barnes detail: recovery of Lindenblatt's body "extreme and dangerous," three to four ridges south and west of Marble.
